name: seo-cockpit
description: Mods companion for claude-seo: a spend guard on paid SEO APIs, a live audit band with a receipt, an economy mode, a visual cockpit (Search Console, rankings, Core Web Vitals, audit, Maps, spend) and zero-token commands

claudeSeoRoot.title: claude-seo folder
claudeSeoRoot.description: Where claude-seo is installed. Leave empty to find it next to this plugin.

python.title: Python command
python.description: Interpreter for the stdlib-only cost ledger script (python3, python, or a full path).

spendGuard.title: Spend guard
spendGuard.description: Hold paid SEO API calls (DataForSEO, Ahrefs, Firecrawl, image generation, Moz, and others; see the README) against the claude-seo budget before they run.

auditBand.title: Audit band
auditBand.description: Show a live line above the prompt while a /seo audit runs: agents running and done, findings written, spend, time.

economy.title: Economy mode
economy.description: Run the five Opus agents (content, geo, sxo, cluster, drift) on Sonnet to cut audit cost. Their analysis may be less thorough.

site.title: Default site
site.description: The site the cockpit opens on when the folder shows none: claude-seo.md, sc-domain:claude-seo.md or https://claude-seo.md/. A site chosen in a folder, or that folder's audit, still comes first.

pageUrl.title: Page for Core Web Vitals
pageUrl.description: For the Vitals and drift views of the default site: a URL or origin. Leave empty to use the site's home page.

auditsFolder.title: Audits folder
auditsFolder.description: Where you keep your audits (the <site>-audit/ folders /seo audit writes). The cockpit finds the shown site's audit there from any folder.

googleAccount.title: Google account
googleAccount.description: Which Google sign-in claude-seo uses for Search Console. auto: claude-seo's own order (its sign-in, then a service account, then your gcloud account). gcloud: always your account from 'gcloud auth application-default login', for properties you own.

googleApiKey.title: Google API key
googleApiKey.description: For Core Web Vitals (CrUX) and PageSpeed. Kept in Claude Code's secure storage. Leave empty to use claude-seo's own setup.
